evidence_modules.domain: ModelEncoding.Translates composes original EncodingMaps.lookupFirst with EncodingDecoder.decode on the held String descriptions and original Codewords. finiteRoundTrip derives total lookup and exact decoding for every admitted source item from validateEncoding and exactDecoder. registeredTranslation uses the registered shared code coverage to derive a held target description and both forward and reverse table relations. No replacement serialization, machine model or algorithm is attributed to V3. ModelEncoding.registeredExecution starts from an admitted original System and successful native run. nativePath recovers the complete predecessor trace and terminal; executionStates establishes carrier membership. registeredReconstruction derives target carrier membership and reverse decoding from the actual validated finite encoding tables. The theorem constructs the original target run, retains the complete observed trace and derives exact reverse reconstruction of the source terminal. The theorem applies in each direction with the two registered grammars/tables and their step-or-trace simulation exchanged. The source simulation condition remains explicit; no universal equivalence of arbitrary unregistered models is asserted.
